notes.title: 7.2 patch： Fix UI problem in different resolution.
notes.content:
不同分辨率下，UI元素位置会出现影响操作的问题，现已修复。
游戏对1920*1080及以上的分辨率有更好的体验。
In different resolution, UI elements position will in wrong place, no is fixed.
1920*1080 or higher resolution wil get best game experience.

tags.bug: In different resolution, UI elements position will in wrong place, no is fixed.

notes.title: 6.29 patch: Fix Hot zone problem in puzzle Challenge
notes.content:
Puzzle Challenge Hot Zone Problem:
Due to possible conflicts between the puzzle hotspot and some character hotspots at the bottom, there may be difficulties in dragging and dropping puzzles.

It has been fixed now, and I deeply apologize for the unpleasant experience for players. I still hope that players can support the work of one Developer for  two years .
Thank you

tags.bug: It has been fixed now, and I deeply apologize for the unpleasant experience for players.
